title: Ordinary direct-image normal forms for the unrestricted reference-rank predicate
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation, and let $E,F$ be finite locally free modules on $X$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. For every $s\in S$ there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $s$ such that one of the following holds. Either there is $r\in\mathbf N$ such that for every $g:T\to U$, the predicate $R_1(f,E,F,\iota_U\circ g)$ [def-sc-picard-universal-single-rank-match] is equivalent to the ordinary direct image of the pullback of $F$ being finite locally free of rank $r$ after every further test $h:T^{\prime}\to T$; or for every $g:T\to U$ the same predicate is equivalent to $T$ being empty. The first alternative includes empty fibres with $r=0$; the second applies to mixed-rank fibres. No derived category or complex is part of this conclusion.

source.place: first three proof paragraphs, ordinary rank comparison; homogeneous, empty and mixed-fibre adaptation in steps 1-5 of lem-sc-picard-single-rank-unrestricted-perfect-chart

proof.text: Use the localRank, exists_localRank, localRank_isClopen, tensorPullback_rank_iff and rank_unique API of PicardFiberRankClopen. Properness and flat local finite presentation make the image of X, the image of any rank locus, and the image of its complement clopen. Split first on whether s belongs to the image of f, and then on whether all points above s have one local rank.

If all points above s have local rank r and the fibre is nonempty, take U to be the image of X intersected with the complement of the image of the bad rank locus. Every pullback of E over U has rank r by tensorPullback_rank_iff. The range formula for pullback.snd provides a point above any local test point, so rank_unique forces each rank n in a reference witness to equal r. Convert tensor restriction to ordinary pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints and glue fixed-rank local freeness using Modules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_isOpenImmersion. Conversely, restrict the assumed global direct-image rank to the top open; the reference pullback already has rank r.

If the fibre is nonempty without one rank, choose a point of rank a and a point outside its rank-a locus. Take U to be the intersection of the images of that locus and its complement. A reference witness at a nonempty test point gives rank n on its entire inverse image. The range formula for pullback.fst lifts both kinds of points to that inverse image. The rank criterion and localRank_unique force n=a, then force the point in the complement to have rank a, a contradiction. Thus tests satisfying the predicate are empty; on empty tests the predicate is vacuous.

If the fibre is empty, take U to be the complement of the image of X. Every pullback source over U is empty, by the pullback commutative square. Its module is zero and pushforward preserves zero objects. Identify the zero direct image with the free module on ULift (Fin 0), proving rank zero. Modules on empty schemes have every fixed rank by the empty open cover. These facts supply rank-zero witnesses on the top open after every test, and give the rank-zero direct-image condition independently of the predicate.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_picardRankMatchDirectImageNormalForm
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (E F : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] [F.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (s : S) :
    ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧
      ((∃ r : ℕ, ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ U.toScheme),
        PicardUniversalSingleRankMatch f E F (g ≫ U.ι) ↔
          ∀ (T' : Scheme.{u}) (h : T' ⟶ T),
            SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
              ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g ≫ U.ι))).obj
                ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (h ≫ g ≫ U.ι))).obj F)) r) ∨
      (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ U.toScheme),
        PicardUniversalSingleRankMatch f E F (g ≫ U.ι) ↔ IsEmpty T))
